searchText: We're they geo distributed, with some running on unreliable internet connections? Geo-distributed = Yes, 3 regions (NYC, Frankfurt and Bangalore). Unreliable internet = No, or rather, as reliable as the public internet is. I dont think the testing plan of the shadow forks so far included enforcing dropped packets, etc. Seems like difficulty progressed different than expected, so we have to change the TTD value for `goerli-shadow-fork-4`. The new TTD value is: `9895202` Updated configs found here: https://github.com/eth-clients/merge-testnets/tree/main/goerli-shadow-fork-4 EF nodes have already been updated with the new TTD. I checked a couple of combinations manually, everything looked good. But it'd be great if client teams could update the TTD on their local nodes as well as raise an alarm if they see something weird on the network. TTD is still planned for tomorrow morning, we should be able to observe the transition in person ^ Contact me for any emergency client updates
